name: Item scaling: a chest opened by a level-scaled character holds its items lifted to the character's content level
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1, DestinyWeaver.Scaling.Offset=3 and CoA.ItemScaling=1. Defias Turncoat's Jerkin 1345037 holds Defias Turncoat's Jerkin 500815 (green, item level 10, required level 5, 36 armor, not Worldforged) at 100%. A level 30 character with open-world scaling on meets content at level 27, so the jerkin it loots must be a copy lifted by 15 levels: item level 25, required level 20 and more armor than the authored 36. With scaling off, Underbed Glint 90550 holds the authored Rootbark Girdle 521000 at item level 11. Lock, key and skill checks of the chest are not exercised; client rendering of the copy is not tested.

steps.label: The chest holds a copy of Defias Turncoat's Jerkin
The copy is lifted to item level 25
The copy carries more armor than the authored 36
The looted copy keeps item level 25
The unscaled chest holds the authored Rootbark Girdle
The authored item keeps item level 11
